verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a My Cake Portal where investors see their own holdings and linked certificates under admin-controlled visibility. That is an adjacent stakeholder portal, not a permissioned, diligence-ready data room combining cap table views and underlying documents for counsel and investors. No data room, counsel access, or document-repository sharing is documented.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors
